blurb: Guests ride jetskis guided by experienced staff from Long Beach to Catalina Island or along the coast. The full-day Catalina trips include about 1.5 hours jetski ride each way and 3 hours free time on the island. The coastal tour is a 2-hour guided jetski ride along the California coast from Palos Verdes to Huntington Pier.
